# osapi pki key

List, make and rotate the keys of osapi on this host.
`osapi dsl command get --name pki key` shows the same.

## Group

|             |                                                      |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | pki key                                              |
| Description | List, make and rotate the keys of osapi on this host |

| Description | List the keys, with their state, algorithm and fingerprint or ID |

## [osapi pki key get](../../usage/cli/pki/key/get.md)

|             |                                                                                |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Method      | get                                                                            |
| Description | Show one key in full; the agent's key has the command that admits this machine |
